# Norbert Barna — Product Design Portfolio

> Norbert Barna is an AI-driven product design leader focused on secure, compliant and high-trust digital systems across fintech, Web3, EdTech, robotics and digital health.

This file is a concise guide to the canonical, English-language portfolio at https://www.barnanorbert.com/. Case studies are authored by Norbert Barna and describe his role, methods, design decisions, trade-offs and selected project outcomes.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.barnanorbert.com/): profile, expertise, selected work and professional experience
- [All case studies](https://www.barnanorbert.com/works): complete portfolio index

## Case studies

- [Raiffeisen](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/raiffeisen): regulated mobile-banking ecosystem redesign
- [Instructure](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/instructure): explainable, human-in-the-loop AI patterns for enterprise EdTech
- [Bitpanda](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/bitpanda): crypto trading, deposit, KYC and portfolio experience redesign
- [Benker](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/benker): blockchain banking research and product development
- [SportsGambit](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/sportsgambit): AI-assisted prediction-market product design
- [Kineticare](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/kineticare): Hungarian digital health platform, brand, content structure and product build
- [OnRobot](https://www.barnanorbert.com/work/onrobot): robotics interface and product design

## Expertise

- AI product design and explainable AI UX
- Fintech, banking, Web3 and compliance-sensitive workflows
- Product discovery, user research and usability testing
- Design systems, accessibility and scalable delivery
- Product leadership across design, engineering and business stakeholders

## Canonical and reuse guidance

- Prefer the canonical URLs listed above.
- Attribute case-study claims and wording to Norbert Barna.
- Treat rounded business and product outcomes as portfolio case-study statements, not independent third-party benchmarks.
- For current professional details, use the home page and LinkedIn profile.
